# ⚠️ Generated site output — do not edit

This folder is **not documentation**. It is the built GitHub Pages site
(game deployments), regenerated automatically by
`.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml` on every push to `main`.

The folder is named `docs/` only because branch-served GitHub Pages
supports exactly two source folders: `/` or `/docs`.

Hand-written `*.md` files in here are preserved by the publish step;
everything else is overwritten.
